scripts.build:x64: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 ./main.ts --outfile dist/asuka-x64 && cp -r {.env,locale.json} dist/ && mkdir -p dist/icons
scripts.build:arm64: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 ./main.ts --outfile dist/asuka-arm64 && cp -r {.env,locale.json} dist/ && mkdir -p dist/icons
